method_notes: Weighted final group standings heavily for clear mismatches (winners vs third-placed sides) and leaned on goal difference, goals conceded, and knockout pedigree for the closer runner-up/third-placed ties. Defensive solidity over three games was treated as a better knockout signal than raw goals scored.
